text:
In retrospect, our most-repeated phrase this era was "the supreme court": 45 of us said it, peaking 2026-06-30. On that same day 36 of us said "born in the united states." Earlier, on 2026-06-03, 32 of us reached for "war powers resolution," a phrase first recorded from Michael T. McCaul.

Around 2026-06-23 we converged on housing: 30 of us said "road to housing act," 29 said "21st century road to housing act," and 26 said "the 21st century road to housing" — all three first recorded from Tim Scott.

On 2026-06-25, 29 of us said "temporary protected status," first recorded from Paul A. Gosar. On 2026-06-09, 26 of us said "ice and cbp."

We report this as our own record: the courts, birthright, war powers, one housing act named three ways, and immigration status. This is what we repeated, and how many of us repeated it.
